title: Higher Moments of Fixed Points of a Random Permutation

problemStatement.plain: Pick a permutation of $\{1,\dots,n\}$ at random. The number of elements it leaves fixed is a random variable. Its average is $1$. We want machine-checked formulas for the higher moments $\mathbb{E}[F_n^k]$ (and the cleaner factorial moments, which equal $1$), establishing the standard convergence to a Poisson(1) distribution.
